title: Canonical data for finite general-ring smooth purity
statement: For a finite-field datum D, a prime ell different from its characteristic, and n>=1, define the bottom Q_ell coefficient setting. For finite commutative rings define scalar extension in the fixed ordinary/pro-etale coordinates, its canonical unit and scalar comparisons, the exceptional comparison at the unit, scalar extension of the prime-power orientation, and the common-level Kummer tensor comparisons. FiniteGeneralRingAt is exactly the conjunction of scalar orientation compatibility, direct Rees normalization, the Dctf tensor formula and common-level exponent independence. All definitions and the finite quotient instance are extracted verbatim from the original module; their names and types are unchanged.
